{"metadata":{"description":"dsh-usage-ledger（Token 费用统计）— 自动记下每笔对话花了多少 Token、多少钱（按对话、按天、累计都能查），价格自动跟着官方最新价走、支持多家国产厂商，低谷时段自动按便宜价算，预算超了自动提醒还能拦下调用，带可视化仪表盘。","id":"gh:1334280477","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-usage-ledger","slug":"beijingwahw/dsh-usage-ledger","topics":["cost-control","deepseek-harness","dsh-plugin","token-usage"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"dsh-usage-ledger（Token 费用统计）— 自动记下每笔对话花了多少 Token、多少钱（按对话、按天、累计都能查），价格自动跟着官方最新价走、支持多家国产厂商，低谷时段自动按便宜价算"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"，预算超了自动提醒还能拦下调用，带可视化仪表盘。"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-usage-ledger ( Token费用统计 )"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**中文** | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness 的 Token / 用量统计与成本控制插件：按对话聚合消耗、动态跟随官方定价、支持预算拦截，并内置 Web 仪表盘。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"## 功能特性"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **按会话统计**：监听 `session/event`，把每次 `assistant/message` 的 `usage`（输入 / 输出 / 缓存读写 Token）折算为费用，按会话、按北京日"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"、按生命周期三个维度聚合，并持久化到账本文件。
- **动态官方定价**：定期抓取官方定价页，自动解析并热更新价格，官方调价 / 上新模型时无需改代码即可生效。
- **DeepSeek 峰谷分时**"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"：识别官方「高峰 / 空闲」时段表与生效日期，按调用发生的北京时间实时取价。
- **多厂商价格目录**：覆盖 DeepSeek、智谱 GLM、月之暗面 Kimi、阿里通义、字节豆包、MiniMax、"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"百度文心等主流国产模型，新模型上线官方定价页后自动导入。
- **预算控制**：支持日 / 总 / 单会话三级预算，达到阈值进入告警，超限可通过 `llm/stream` 钩子直接拦截模型调用。
- "},{"id":"p6s5","text":"**Web 仪表盘**：通过 `dsh-host-webserver` 注册 `/usage-ledger` 路由，提供用量可视化与 JSON API。
- **用户覆盖价**：`customPric"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"es` 设置可为任意模型（含自定义模型）覆盖或补充价格，优先级最高。"},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"### 一键安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"> 常用进阶命令：升级 `dsh plugin upgrade dsh-usage-ledger --profile web`；卸载 `dsh plugin remove dsh-usage-ledg"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"er --profile web`；本地路径安装 `dsh plugin add ./dsh-usage-ledger --profile web`。"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"Harness 通过 `dsh.plugin.json` 与 `cordis.patch.yml` 自动加载插件，`lib/` 随仓库分发，无需本地构建。"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"## 配置"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"在 Harness 的 `cordis.yml` 中挂载并配置："},{"id":"p14s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p15s1","text":"`usage-ledger` 命名空间的用户设置（可在运行时热更新）："},{"id":"p16s1","text":"| 设置 | 默认 | 说明 |"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"| `dailyBudget` | `0` | 日预算（元），0 关闭 |
| `totalBudget` | `0` | 总预算（元），0 关闭 |
| `sessionBudget` | `0` "},{"id":"p17s2","text":"| 单会话预算（元），0 关闭 |
| `warnRatio` | `0.8` | 进入告警的预算占比 |
| `enforceBudget` | `true` | 超预算时拦截模型调用 |
| `p"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"ricingUrl` | DeepSeek 官方页 | 定价刷新来源 |
| `refreshIntervalMin` | `60` | 定价刷新间隔（分钟） |
| `customPrices` |"},{"id":"p17s4","text":" `{}` | 按模型 id 覆盖价格（最长前缀匹配） |"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"`customPrices` 示例："},{"id":"p19s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"价格单位为 **元 / 百万 tokens**。"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"## 价格解析优先级"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"`用户覆盖 > DeepSeek 实时表 > 各厂商实时抓取表 > 内置目录精确匹配 > 最长前缀匹配`"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"各厂商抓取方式（`fetchKind`）："},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| 厂商 | 通道 |"},{"id":"p25s1","text":"| DeepSeek | 官方定价页 HTML（含峰谷表） |

- `GET /usage-ledger/api/...`：用量与定价 JSON API。"},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## 开发"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p33s1","text":"目录结构："},{"id":"p34s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p35s1","text":"## 参与贡献"},{"id":"p36s1","text":"欢迎提交 Issue 与 Pull Request。请保持改动聚焦，提交前运行 `pnpm run typecheck`。"},{"id":"p37s1","text":"从源码构建安装（贡献者 / 离线场景）："},{"id":"p38s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p39s1","text":"## 许可"},{"id":"p40s1","text":"MIT"},{"id":"p41s1","text":"# dsh-usage-ledger"},{"id":"p42s1","text":"**中文** | English"},{"id":"p43s1","text":"A token usage & cost ledger plugin for DeepSeek Harness: per-session cost aggregation, dynamic offic"},{"id":"p43s2","text":"ial pricing, budget gating, and a built-in web dashboard."},{"id":"p44s1","text":"## Features"},{"id":"p45s1","text":"- **Per-session accounting**: listens to `session/event`, prices every `assistant/message` `usage` r"},{"id":"p45s2","text":"ecord (input / output / cache read & write tokens), and aggregates it per session, per Beijing-time "},{"id":"p45s3","text":"day, and per lifetime, persisting everything to a ledger file.
- **Dynamic official pricing**: perio"},{"id":"p45s4","text":"dically scrapes official pricing pages, parses and hot-reloads prices — official price changes and n"},{"id":"p45s5","text":"ewly published models take effect without any code change.
- **DeepSeek peak/off-peak**: understands"},{"id":"p45s6","text":" the official peak/off-peak schedule and its effective date, resolving the price in force at the exa"},{"id":"p45s7","text":"ct Beijing time of each call.
- **Multi-vendor catalog**: covers DeepSeek, Zhipu GLM, Moonshot Kimi,"},{"id":"p45s8","text":" Alibaba Qwen, ByteDance Doubao, MiniMax and Baidu ERNIE; new models are imported automatically once"},{"id":"p45s9","text":" they appear on an official pricing page.
- **Budget control**: daily / total / per-session budgets "},{"id":"p45s10","text":"with a warning threshold, optionally blocking model calls through the `llm/stream` gate when exceede"},{"id":"p45s11","text":"d.
- **Web dashboard**: registers the `/usage-ledger` route via `dsh-host-webserver`, with usage vis"},{"id":"p45s12","text":"ualization and a JSON API.
- **User price overrides**: the `customPrices` setting can override or ad"},{"id":"p45s13","text":"d prices for any model (including custom ones) and takes top priority."},{"id":"p46s1","text":"## Installation"},{"id":"p47s1","text":"### One-liner"},{"id":"p48s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p49s1","text":"> Common follow-ups: upgrade `dsh plugin upgrade dsh-usage-ledger --profile web`; uninstall `dsh plu"},{"id":"p49s2","text":"gin remove dsh-usage-ledger --profile web`; local-path install `dsh plugin add ./dsh-usage-ledger --"},{"id":"p49s3","text":"h-usage-ledger --profile web`; local-path install `dsh plugin add ./dsh-usage-ledger --profile web`."},{"id":"p50s1","text":"Harness loads it automatically through `dsh.plugin.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`. `lib/` ships in the"},{"id":"p50s2","text":" repo — no local build step needed."}],"truncated":true}
